messages:
mina: Heads-up — saw partial network isolation in AZ25 during last night's preflight. I'm proposing a rolling soft-drain + coordinated node reboots on Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Expect ~10-15% capacity hit for ~2h.

raj: Ack. What caused the isolation?

lisa: Do we have heatmap/alerts? Any P95 latency spikes tied to specific racks?

mina: No single rack root cause yet; BGP flap on a ToR observed, some control-plane jitter. Failing nodes showed repeated netlink errors in dmesg.

sergio: Can we limit blast radius to two cohorts and do canary first?

mina: Yes, plan is: cohort A (20% of AZ25) canary 03:00-03:20, then cohort B 03:30-04:00, remaining cohorts 04:00-05:00. Canary success criteria: no >2% increase in 95th latency and no evictions >5 across pool.

raj: What's the exact operator runbook?

mina: Runbook (short):
1) mark cohort nodes as drain-friendly
2) apply `kubectl drain` with --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data.
3) perform soft BMC reboot on drained nodes, wait for NIC reinit and nvlink health.
4) uncordon and kv-cache reseed for serving runtime.

lisa: Can you paste the commands? ops-team will run them.

mina: Sure:
```
# drain
kubectl drain NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=10m
# soft reboot via bmctool
bmctool reboot NODE --type=soft
# after node ready
kubectl uncordon NODE
# kvcache reseed (internal tool)
kvseed --pool az25 --nodes NODE
```

sergio: Add a step to pre-warm prefix cache on remaining nodes before each cohort. That reduces tail latency.

mina: Good call — will run kvseed 10m before uncordon.

ops-bot: Incident detection rules will create a pager if P95 latency increases > 2.5% for 5m.

raj: How much extra cost do we expect from backfill (spot/ondemand)? Need estimate to inform finance.

mina: Short calc: Cohort A uses 20% spare backfill; if backfill on on-demand for 2h, rough cost delta ~ $6500/hour for AZ25 (high density). For full window worst-case ~ $13k. I'll surface exact numbers in the post.

lisa: Is there any traffic we should throttle? Any high-priority tenants to move?

mina: We have 3 priority tenants pinned to AZ25. Plan: migrate one tenant to EU fallback ahead of the window (pre-move during low-traffic), the others will be covered by reserved capacity. Will notify tenant owners.

sergio: Suggest adding temporary routing policy: prefer eu fallback for new requests during the window. Less stateful migrations.

mina: Agree. I'll add a smart-routing policy to prefer eu-west failover for new sessions between 03:00-05:30 UTC.

raj: Communication plan? Support + SRE + Sales?

mina: Draft comms: internal + tenant email + status page update 24h and 1h before. Support will have runbook and slack channel pinned.

lisa: Who's oncall and who runs the canary?

mina: Oncall: raj. Canary lead: sergio. Ops run: lisa and me.

ops-bot: Reminder: create maintenance window ticket in PagerDuty and set reminder 30m before.

sergio: One more ask — capture KV cache hit rates and token cost delta during canary. If cost jumps >10% we abort.

mina: Added abort criteria: any of:
- P95 latency delta > 2% sustained 5m
- Evictions > 5 during cohort
- Cost per token increase > 10% during canary window

raj: LGTM. I'll prep the terraform to spin temporary backfill nodes as needed.

lisa: I'll draft tenant comms and post to #customer-success.

mina: Thanks all — will update runbook and post final schedule in this thread. :thumbsup:
